criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a real render on a dark field, encodings honest and measured. The jack is a black silhouette on 1, 4 and 9 with a plastic crank. 3 primitive cylinders, a dead left half, the footer on the column. 7 flat white rings, flat stands, a moire object behind, empty bottom. Accent props are flat painted shapes on 5, 6 and 8. 6 a mid-tone olive frame with cropped base. 4 corrugated ribbing and long leaders. 2 a mid-grey page with a flat curl shadow. 9 strongest. Below the 7 descriptor, well above the 4.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, register and accent, the jack recurring. Stroke motif unreadable, sky splits, 6 the one mid-tone frame. The camera move is real.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and was re-derived. Loose: slide 8's hook drops 'by oil and gas companies' (the dek restores it) and rests on the Tribune; the caption's 'quoted experts' and 'Permian operators' are looser than c28; copy.json's caption was stale. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who are clear and slide 3 turns well. No Texas county; the meeting is a date with no stated link to this item.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 3 and 8 turn, the close lands. 6 cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific, oilfield literate, unboosterish. 6's headline is flat; the drawn-to-illustrate disclaimers read as hedging.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First oilfield subject in the window. lastLight again, scenes plus reliefs as in no. 67, the shut ranch gate close as in nos. 54 and 62.

ship_note: Round 3 is max_rounds, so the deck ships at the cap under the 7.7 rung with the shortfall named. No hard fail found.
one_sentence_fix: Re-aim the chassis key so a warm grazing light rakes the recurring jack on 1, 3, 4 and 9, and give every figure prop a lit material.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat white rings read as a dot chart; flat stands; a moire object; empty bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bevelled tool joints with worn faces and a key rim; camera to about 1.0 m pushed in; delete the background object.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured primitives, dead left half, footer on the column.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera about 0.6 m right and lower; a hard work light on the rod; grime on the tee and flanges; keep the column off the footer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cover jack near-pure black; only the plastic crank lit.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A warm back rim at 10 to 20 degrees opposite the camera; worn paint on the crank.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-tone olive frame, flat plank and target, cropped base.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darker tank albedo with one raking edge; camera up so the wall and contact enter; a lit enamel float casting on the board.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stepped two-tone rods, square couplings, flat tag, dead band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Round height field with a specular; round couplings with flats; raised brass tag with a cast; rods up about 150 px.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-grey page, flat curl shadow, box clip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raking pool to near white at the edge; a curl with real height; a wire clip.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Corrugated ribbing; small black jack; long leaders.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Noise bedding; camera in about 30 percent; shorter leaders.
